quarterly_data.quarter: nVent press release: nVent Completes Acquisition of Maverick Power (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: nVent completed the previously announced acquisition of Maverick Power, a manufacturer of engineered power distribution and infrastructure solutions for data centers (headquartered in McKinney, Texas, with approximately 900 employees in Texas and Arizona). The release says the deal broadens nVent's exposure to the infrastructure vertical, particularly data centers, with a power distribution platform. Chair and CEO Beth Wozniak: Maverick Power 'adds a power distribution platform to our portfolio, which complements our current data center offerings' and 'expands our offerings for new power architectures, and system-level solutions and services for data centers'.
